title: Investigate search ranking drop before changing relevance logic
raw_problem: Product search conversion dropped after yesterday's catalog sync. The team wants to tune ranking weights immediately. Should we change ranking logic or inspect indexing and sync quality first?
recommended_next_action: Check index freshness, missing fields, and top-query result diffs before changing ranking weights; only tune relevance after confirming the index pipeline is healthy.
open_questions: Did catalog sync change field completeness, availability, or boosts?
Are top queries missing expected products or just ordered differently?
Does a replay against the previous index restore conversion-sensitive result sets?
